evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: If the employee has successfully completed his/her probationary contract and at least three (3) subsequent and consecutive annual contracts with the District, he/she shall be issued another annual contract, if he/she:... II. Received a rating of “Effective” or “Highly Effective” on his/her most recent annual evaluation... III. Has not received two consecutive annual performance evaluation ratings of “Unsatisfactory”... or three (3) consecutive annual performance evaluation ratings of “Needs Improvement”...
